$comment: Use "" for unavailable text, [] for empty collections, and null for unavailable measurements or condition values. Neither implies zero or explicit absence. Use a strict JSON parser rejecting duplicate keys, NaN, and Infinity. Pydantic additionally validates bounds, primary-location consistency, and unique observation IDs.

Measurement.description: Reported central value or bounds, preserving original units.

value.description: Reported single or central value; null or omitted if unavailable.
value.title: Value

min.description: Reported lower endpoint or bound; null or omitted if unavailable.
min.title: Min

max.description: Reported upper endpoint or bound; null or omitted if unavailable.
max.title: Max

unit.description: Original reported unit. Include the stated electrode reference for potentials, e.g. 'mV (SCE)' or 'V (Ag/AgCl, saturated KCl)'. Use an empty string or omit for dimensionless quantities or unavailable units. Do not infer units or electrode details.
unit.title: Unit

plus_minus.description: Reported symmetric uncertainty in the same unit as value; requires a numerical value. Do not infer from bounds or substitute relative percent uncertainty. Null or omitted if unavailable.
plus_minus.title: Plus Minus

Measurement.title: Measurement

NamedValue.description: A condition or coordinate used to identify a particular outcome.

name.description: Paper's label for this coordinate or condition, e.g. Nb content, pH, or test method.
name.title: Name

value.description: Reported text/categorical value, a measurement for a numerical value (including dimensionless numbers), or null if unreadable/unavailable. Preserve original terminology and units.
value.title: Value

NamedValue.title: NamedValue

observation_id.description: Registry-scoped bookkeeping identifier, e.g. obs_001; preserve during later edits and enrichment.
observation_id.title: Observation Id

result_type.description: Origin of the potential selected from primary_location: reported_experimental for the authors' experiments (including routine summaries), interpolated or calculated when explicitly derived, cited when attributed to another source, reference_value when explicitly standard/conventional, or unclear when origin is not established. Digitization is a reading method, not interpolation. Scientific uncertainty alone does not change a known experimental origin.
result_type.title: Result Type

extraction_status.description: complete: recovered as far as the paper supplies, with a non-null potential and empty failure_notes; partial: a recovery problem remains but useful input survives; failed: recovery is insufficient for automatic downstream processing. partial/failed require nonblank failure_notes. Default routing continues complete/partial and retains failed for review; it does not certify scientific validity or benchmark suitability.
extraction_status.title: Extraction Status

pitting_potential.description: Exact copy of the primary location's measurement, without conversion or averaging; null when that reading is null.

sample_label.description: Author-supplied sample/alloy identifier; empty string if unavailable. Do not invent one.
sample_label.title: Sample Label

association_notes.description: Brief paper-derived clue linking this outcome to its experimental context; empty string if unnecessary. Not a full methods summary.
association_notes.title: Association Notes

result_note.description: Scientific qualifications, provenance or measurement-criterion uncertainty, source disagreements, and unresolved duplicate relationships. Include statistical meanings, inequalities, or reported no-pitting limits when relevant. Empty string if unnecessary.
result_note.title: Result Note

failure_notes.description: Information the extractor could not recover despite the paper appearing to provide it, e.g. illegible digits or unreadable legend assignments. Empty for complete observations; nonblank for partial/failed. Source omissions, scientific uncertainty, and source conflicts belong in result_note and do not alone make extraction incomplete.
failure_notes.title: Failure Notes

primary_location.description: Zero-based index of the preferred reading in locations.
primary_location.title: Primary Location

locations.description: Specific paper locations reporting this same outcome; retain each location's original reading and units.
locations.title: Locations

pdf_page.description: One-based page number in the supplied PDF, not the printed page number.
pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

printed_page.description: Printed page label, including prefixes if present; empty string if unavailable.
printed_page.title: Printed Page

reading_method.description: Transcribed for printed numerical values; digitized when a numerical value or endpoint is read graphically.
reading_method.title: Reading Method

pitting_potential.description: Pitting outcome as read at this location, in its original units/reference. Null if no numerical value or bound can be recovered. Never insert a converted value.

figure_label.description: Printed figure identifier; empty string if absent or unreadable.
figure_label.title: Figure Label

panel_label.description: Panel label such as (b); empty string for an unlabeled or single-panel figure.
panel_label.title: Panel Label

series_label.description: Legend/series label and distinguishing symbol, e.g. Alloy B, open circles; empty string if unavailable.
series_label.title: Series Label

coordinates.description: Independent-variable coordinates identifying the point, in original units; [] if none can be recovered.
coordinates.title: Coordinates

pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

printed_page.description: Printed page label, including prefixes if present; empty string if unavailable.

reading_method.description: Transcribed for printed numerical values; digitized when a numerical value or endpoint is read graphically.
reading_method.title: Reading Method

pitting_potential.description: Pitting outcome as read at this location, in its original units/reference. Null if no numerical value or bound can be recovered. Never insert a converted value.

table_label.description: Printed table identifier; empty string if absent or unreadable.
table_label.title: Table Label

row_label.description: Row/sample label or concise distinguishing row description; empty string if unavailable.
row_label.title: Row Label

column_label.description: Full result-column label, including scoped headers, units, and method distinction when stated.
column_label.title: Column Label

conditions.description: Additional reported conditions needed to identify the cell; [] if none extracted.
conditions.title: Conditions

pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

printed_page.description: Printed page label, including prefixes if present; empty string if unavailable.

reading_method.description: Transcribed for printed numerical values; digitized when a numerical value or endpoint is read graphically.
reading_method.title: Reading Method

pitting_potential.description: Pitting outcome as read at this location, in its original units/reference. Null if no numerical value or bound can be recovered. Never insert a converted value.

section_heading.description: Section heading containing the outcome; empty string if absent or unreadable.
section_heading.title: Section Heading

text_anchor.description: Short exact identifying quotation, sufficient to find the passage; empty string if unreadable.
text_anchor.title: Text Anchor

description: Condition-specific numerical outcomes and paper-derived anchors from one paper.

paper_name.description: Filename of the supplied paper PDF, including extension and excluding directory.
paper_name.title: Paper Name

reference_number.description: Supplied literature reference or leading positive filename number; null if unavailable.
reference_number.title: Reference Number

observations.description: One record per identifiable, condition-specific numerical pitting-related value or bound, including incomplete recovery of such occurrences. Consolidate only supported equivalent presentations; broad screening ranges and purely qualitative statements belong in the report.
observations.title: Observations
